venue: Westgate Cabaret at Westgate Las Vegas

zones.label: VIP
zones.description: VIP is the closest seating section to the stage. Choose it when being as near to the performance as possible matters most.

zones.label: Main Floor
zones.description: The Main Floor is our pick. It keeps you closer than the Balcony while giving you more distance from the stage than VIP for a balanced overall view.

zones.label: Balcony
zones.description: The Balcony sits behind and above the main seating area on the chart. Choose it when you want the widest perspective on the stage.
